answer: The protocol validates autonomous agents by reserving 1,000 distinct operational slots, treating each reservation as a quartz-timed anchor that prohibits capacity pooling. A verifier monitors occupancy by measuring latency to a ferrous-shielded data mesa, ensuring every agent maintains its own dedicated bandwidth without relaying signals through shared hardware. Honest agents pay 1x cost, whereas an attacker must pay 1,000x for isolated slots. Failed audits trigger immediate identity revocation with zero refund.
